definitions.explanation: A person who has recently joined a group, organization, or field. Emphasizes that they are new and not yet well-known to others.

examples.japanese: ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{新顔|しんがお}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{加|くわ}わった→加わる：01940_kuwawaru⟧。
examples.english: A new face joined the team.

examples.japanese: ⟦{芸能界|げいのうかい}→芸能界：15094_geinoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{新顔|しんがお}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{注目|ちゅうもく}→注目：03483_chuumoku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She's getting attention as a newcomer in the entertainment industry.

examples.japanese: {新顔|しんがお}だ⟦からといって→からといって：30623_karatoitte⟧⟦{遠慮|えんりょ}する→遠慮する：19518_enryosuru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There's no need to hold back just because you're new.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{新|しん} (new) + ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (face)

Literally "new face" - emphasizes that the person is not yet recognized or familiar to others.

USAGE:
Generally neutral to positive. Can imply:
- Fresh perspective
- Not yet established
- Unknown quantity
- Potential/promise

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{芸能界|げいのうかい}→芸能界：15094_geinoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{新顔|しんがお} - newcomer in entertainment
- ⟦{政界|せいかい}→政界：15196_seikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{新顔|しんがお} - new face in politics
- {新顔|しんがお}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧ - new player
- {新顔|しんがお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧ - to welcome a newcomer

CONTRASTED WITH:
- ⟦{古株|ふるかぶ}→古株：07457_furukabu⟧ - old-timer, veteran
- ⟦{顔馴染|かおなじ}み→顔馴染み：07305_kaonajimi⟧ - familiar face
- ⟦ベテラン→ベテラン：11121_beteran⟧ - veteran

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧ - newcomer (more common in workplace)
- {新入|しんにゅう}り - new member (formal)
- ⟦{新参|しんざん}→新参：20460_shinzan⟧ - newcomer (slightly formal)
- ⟦ルーキー→ルーキー：27859_ruukii⟧ - rookie (sports/loanword)
